description: In crates/mail/src/server.rs mta_sts_handler (line 386), the handler calls render_mta_sts_policy which always computes a SHA-256 digest + HEXLOWER encode + String alloc for policy_id, then immediately discards it (stored as _policy_id). This is unnecessary work on every /.well-known/mta-sts.txt HTTP request. Fix: either split render_mta_sts_policy into body-only and id functions, or have the handler call a body-only variant that skips the hash computation.
title: P2: render_mta_sts_policy discards policy_id on every HTTP request
